gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lao: Tourney stretches its words wide, every stroke a ribbon of constant width, with small letters that look oversized and bulky. And Noto Sans Lao handles the quieter work, lifting its lowercase high with mouths that stay open on a plain sans frame.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Noto Sans Lao Looped sets its words as solid blocks instead of skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Tourney's wirelike strokes hold the top.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Wide-set and athletic, Tourney draws counters framed by strokes of one width, with bulky small letters. Noto Sans Lepcha takes over below with curves that stay widely open and a lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals, though shrinking the heading would crowd those tight frames.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Stretched, chunky and athletic, Tourney keeps its curves full right through the shoulders instead of thinning. But Noto Sans Limbu is the one built for steady reading, a plain sans with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Approachable is how Noto Sans Lydian feels, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase and an opening like a sprung paper clip. And under Tourney's wire-like monoline skeleton, a longer passage would move along smoothly, with no jolt between the two.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani reads modern and brisk, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals while the e flares like a funnel. Tourney hits hardest with its pulse-free, one-width strokes; the sans does its best work in the lines beneath.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle of the line, so its texture feels dense and its s opens generously at every bend. Noto Sans Malayalam is the pair's strongest quality, a sturdy sans under Tourney's wide-tracked, arch-matching r, n and m.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Tourney looks wire-bent from one end of a word to the other, wide-tracked and bulky in its small letters. And Noto Sans Mandaic keeps the supporting text lively, its lowercase rising close to capitals, while Tourney earns its keep big and short.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Tourney's marker-nib line ignores direction entirely, so each stretched, bulky word looks pressed out in one confident pass. Noto Sans Marchen does the opposite job, a plain sans with proud small letters and curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Tourney is all muscle and width. Its strokes carry no calligraphic modulation, while Noto Sans Mayan Numerals answers with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, and that gap between them is what holds your attention.
